A man has been walking the earth for five thousand years, with a wound that never heals. Stay till the end, because Krishna Himself gave him that curse.

As the story goes, after the great war, Ashwatthama was mad with rage. In the dead of night, he attacked the Pandava camp while everyone slept. But he still wasn't satisfied. He fired the deadliest weapon, the Brahmastra, at an unborn child.

Krishna stepped in, and saved the baby inside the womb. Then He turned to Ashwatthama. Wait, what did Krishna do? He took the shining gem from Ashwatthama's forehead, and said, you will wander alone for thousands of years, with a wound that never heals.
Some say he still walks the forests today.
That's why we say, never let anger make your choices. Anger lasts a moment. Its pain lasts forever. Comment Krishna, and send this to someone who needs to calm down.
